# Payment designs (fixture, text description of 4 frames)

1. "Review order": items, total, saved card, "Pay" button.
2. "Processing": spinner, text "Processing your payment".
3. "Payment failed": red icon, text "Your payment could not be completed. Your bank declined the transaction." Single button: "Back to home".
4. "Order confirmed": check icon, "Order #<number> confirmed", button "Track order".
